execution_capture.command_format: Exact argv arrays supplied to subprocess.run; no shell interpretation is implied.
execution_capture.timestamps: UTC values recorded immediately before/after each subprocess; concurrent records may overlap.
execution_capture.log_capture: stdout followed by stderr, not a globally ordered interleaving. The checked-in ledger retains exact arguments, timestamps, exits, test totals, relevant failure excerpts and raw-log SHA-256 digests.
execution_capture.filesystem: Execution occurred in the agent workspace, not on the owner’s Dell/WSL/Windows computer.

intermediate_failure_dispositions.disposition: preserveEntrySignatures alone did not retain the browser entry exports. Add the explicit browser input, then inspect exported app/mount API. The browser checkpoint uses its manifest to import the cached public entry. Smoke checks select the actual /assets/browser-*.js chunk from generated HTML. Worker policy/bindings and dependencies remain unchanged.

The scenario disposed the app during synchronous connecting before its one-shot network abort had been consumed; remount then consumed that pending interception and legitimately required an extra attempt. Wait for explicit Retry feedback before disposal to prove an actual pending retry and avoid carrying the interception across remount. No runtime fix was needed.

Vite HMR reloaded the document during runtime restart. CDP retained old-document SSE request IDs without terminal Network events, so a global request set incorrectly attributed them to the remounted app. Scope active ownership by Page.frameNavigated loader ID and retain old IDs explicitly as document-replaced/no-terminal-event-observed evidence. Built mode separately requires no navigation and no retired IDs. Add actual native DOM listener counts before/after disposal.

Guarded local adoption ran before the asynchronous fetch completed and failed because origin/m07/reference-app was not yet present. It stopped before mutation. Fetch completed, then adopt-implementation-after-fetch passed its tree checks and adopted the implementation commit safely.

browser_checkpoints.ownership_limit: Development HMR replaced each document. One old-document SSE request ID per page lacks a terminal CDP event and is retained explicitly in the results, not silently asserted closed or attributed to the new app. Built mode has no navigation after initial load, no retired IDs and a zero entire request census. Both modes end with all pages and browser contexts closed.

policies.application_host: main.tsx delegates construction, mount and disposal to the Todo program; extra state/view consumers start no network effects.
policies.collection_authority: Accepted versioned live snapshots alone replace the collection; HTTP mutation results settle pending operation status and the relevant accepted form draft.
policies.filter: App-local all/active/completed state derives visible rows; filtering starts no HTTP request and changes no saved Todo data.
policies.draft: Capture value and revision at accepted create. Clear only the matching accepted draft; later typing, including changed-away-and-back text, remains.
policies.validation: Pure trimmed required-title validation; no new arbitrary maximum length. Server validation and existing authority capacities remain authoritative.
policies.mutation_policy: Keep input editable during create; Add communicates the existing busy admission policy. Accepted writes use the bounded FIFO queue.
policies.recovery: Visible correlated operation feedback; no automatic mutation replay. A lost reply can follow a committed write, and local cancellation is not rollback.
policies.live_protocol: M06 schema, logical history/revision and current-connection admission remain unchanged; legacy bare-array stream stays supported.
policies.idle_partition_detection: No heartbeat or fixed detection bound after the first snapshot; retry begins on reported transport failure or manual Reconnect.
policies.node_memory: Retained Node history is independent memory. Factory/reset establishes a new generation at revision 0; durable reconstruction instead retains saved history.

limitations: Local workerd/browser evidence does not prove deployment or global Cloudflare routing behavior.
Deployable Todo access remains disabled; no production authentication or release policy is added.
Snapshot transport is bounded by existing application budgets; native socket/browser buffers are not included in those counts.
Optional browser tooling remains outside repository dependencies and normal CI.
